meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when Quantity is negative

plan.title: Reject Negative Quantity in Draft Items

steps.note: Open the Events list so the saved draft can be reached from the Drafts tab.
Confirm the events list rendered before navigating to drafts.
Switch to the saved eRFX drafts.
Open the first saved draft; the draft reopens on its create screen.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft's existing item.
Enter the invalid negative quantity specified by the case.
Enter the specified price for the line item before attempting to save.
Attempt to save the line item; the save must be refused because the quantity is negative.
Assert that Procol reports the quantity validation error.
